segments.text: Elihu also continued, and said,
“Bear with me a little, and I will show you; for I still have something to say on God’s behalf.
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: I will get my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: For truly my words are not false. One who is perfect in knowledge is with you.
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: “Behold, God is mighty, and doesn’t despise anyone. He is mighty in strength of understanding.
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: He doesn’t preserve the life of the wicked, but gives justice to the afflicted.
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: He doesn’t withdraw his eyes from the righteous, but with kings on the throne,
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: he sets them forever, and they are exalted.
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: If they are bound in fetters, and are taken in the cords of afflictions,
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: then he shows them their work, and their transgressions, that they have behaved themselves proudly.
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: He also opens their ears to instruction, and commands that they return from iniquity.
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: If they listen and serve him, they will spend their days in prosperity,
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: and their years in pleasures.
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: But if they don’t listen, they will perish by the sword; they will die without knowledge.
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: “But those who are godless in heart lay up anger. They don’t cry for help when he binds them.
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: They die in youth. Their life perishes among the unclean.
He delivers the afflicted by their affliction, and opens their ear in oppression.
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: Yes, he would have allured you out of distress, into a wide place, where there is no restriction.
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: That which is set on your table would be full of fatness.
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: “But you are full of the judgment of the wicked. Judgment and justice take hold of you.
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: Don’t let riches entice you to wrath, neither let the great size of a bribe turn you aside.
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: Would your wealth sustain you in distress, or all the might of your strength?
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: Don’t desire the night, when people are cut off in their place.
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: Take heed, don’t regard iniquity; for you have chosen this rather than affliction.
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: Behold, God is exalted in his power. Who is a teacher like him?
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: Who has prescribed his way for him? Or who can say, ‘You have committed unrighteousness’?
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: “Remember that you magnify his work, about which men have sung.
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: All men have looked on it. Man sees it afar off.
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: Behold, God is great, and we don’t know him. The number of his years is unsearchable.
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: For he draws up the drops of water, which distill in rain from his vapor,
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: which the skies pour down and which drop on man abundantly.
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: Indeed, can anyone understand the spreading of the clouds and the thunderings of his pavilion?
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: Behold, he spreads his light around him. He covers the bottom of the sea.
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: For by these he judges the people. He gives food in abundance.
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: He covers his hands with the lightning, and commands it to strike the mark.
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: Its noise tells about him, and the livestock also, concerning the storm that comes up.
segments.speaker: Elihu
